_comment: PLAN-35 T10 (section 17 references LibreOffice/PDF.js/DOMPurify by name; this records the exact pinned build of each). Every hash below was cross-checked against jsdelivr own published SRI hash for that exact file at fetch time and confirmed byte-identical -- see the T10 execution-ledger entry for the verification commands. Do not bump a version here without repeating that check and updating the hash. Hashes are computed directly from the files on disk by this same script, never hand-typed.

libraries.name: marked
libraries.purpose: Markdown -> HTML rendering, replacing the previous unpinned https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js import in ai_generator.html.
libraries.global: window.marked (marked.parse(md) -> HTML string; output is NOT sanitized on its own -- always pass through DOMPurify, see aria_markdown.js)

libraries.name: dompurify
libraries.purpose: Sanitizes marked's HTML output before it ever reaches innerHTML -- the actual XSS defense; marked alone passes raw HTML/script through unchanged.

libraries.name: pdfjs-dist
libraries.purpose: Renders a build's PDF preview inline in the browser (canvas), so a draft/version's branded preview never needs a manual download.
libraries.note: ES module build (type=module script tag) -- pdfjs-dist dropped the legacy UMD build in recent major versions. Loaded only by the draft-preview/version-preview UI, never by the print/policy/gap markdown views.

libraries.name: pdfjs-dist worker
libraries.purpose: PDF.js's own background-thread parser, referenced by pdf.min.mjs via GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc -- must be the exact same version as pdf.min.mjs.
